Declare the packages a study needs

Source: R/study_declare.R
study_declare.Rd

Records package names in the study's DESCRIPTION, the file renv reads to build the study's renv.lock in explicit mode. Declaring rather than letting renv scan the code means a stale template copy can never put a package into the lockfile.

Names are only ever added, and an entry already declared stays as written, version constraint included. Every other field of the file is kept. The file is rewritten only when the set changes, and a DESCRIPTION that is not a study project's (no Type: Project) is never edited.

Usage

study_declare(packages = character(0), root = NULL)

Arguments

packages

Character. Package names to declare.

root

Character(1). The study root; by default the study enclosing the working directory, as study_root finds it.

Value

The sorted declared package names, invisibly.

Examples

root <- file.path(tempdir(), "declare-example")
dir.create(root, showWarnings = FALSE)
study_declare("arrow", root)
